title: Warehouse operations agent with protocol tools and human release control
scenario: A logistics company is piloting an AI agent for a warehouse. The system receives sensor observations, plans routes, queries live inventory, and can request a vehicle release. Immediate obstacle avoidance must be fast, while route planning may take longer. Inventory and route capabilities are exposed through a standardized tool protocol with declared schemas. Releasing a vehicle into a shared human work area is consequential and can be difficult to reverse, so the company wants an explicit approval checkpoint. The team is comparing reactive control, reasoning strategies, protocol-level tool discovery, and human oversight in one design.
